# Chicago Bulls 2026/27 NBA Season Preview: Matas Buzelis Breakout Incoming?

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-08-18, 30:30. https://youtu.be/FxaSnyk9g90

## Summary

Josh Lloyd and Hayes from Locked On Bulls preview the 2026/27 Chicago Bulls. The team has a new front office and new head coach Thiago Splitter, and it added Norman Powell, Nic Claxton and rookie Caleb Wilson (No. 4 pick), mostly on short, flexible deals. Matas Buzelis is expected to get more usage, shot volume and ball handling in year three after Billy Donovan kept him on a short leash. Josh Giddey is expected to be the main playmaker, with a target of top three in assists, though he needs to cut turnovers and stay healthy. Both are doubtful that Claxton can rebound from his decline. Leonard Miller is seen as ahead of Patrick Williams in the rotation. Hayes predicts 32 wins, and Josh says he wants to draft Buzelis and sees Wilson as maybe the No. 2 rookie.
